veranderings.rede: 'holte' is the natural Afrikaans word for 'hol plek' and is within Grade 5 reach.

veranderings.voor: die grond lyk anders soos jy dieper kom
veranderings.na: die grond lyk anders wanneer jy dieper kom
veranderings.rede: Temporal 'soos' copies English 'as you go deeper'; Afrikaans uses 'wanneer' (or 'namate').

veranderings.voor: heel bo op die oppervlak en
veranderings.na: heel bo op die oppervlak, en
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb (Bogrond le / die meeste plante het); the protected wording stays intact.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb (die ondergrond le / wortels kom); the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.voor: Rots breek stadig in kleiner stukkies
veranderings.na: Rots breek stadig op in kleiner stukkies
veranderings.rede: The idiomatic separable verb is 'opbreek in' kleiner stukke; 'breek in' alone can read as 'break into'.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb (die son se hitte maak / dit koel af).
'later' reads vague and wooden after 'Dag na dag'; 'uiteindelik' says the cracking comes at the end of the repetition.

veranderings.voor: vat baie langer om te vorm
veranderings.na: het baie langer nodig om te vorm
veranderings.rede: 'vat ... om te' is colloquial and calques English 'takes longer to'; 'het langer nodig om te' is standard and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: nog ander goed in die grond
veranderings.na: nog ander dinge in die grond
veranderings.rede: 'goed' for 'things' is informal; 'dinge' suits a study text.

veranderings.blok: Vier dinge wat die lewe ondersteun
veranderings.voor: wat diere en mense elke keer inasem
veranderings.na: wat diere en mense met elke asemteug inasem
veranderings.rede: 'elke keer' has nothing to refer to; 'met elke asemteug' completes the thought without adding content.

vlae.blok: Vier dinge wat die lewe ondersteun
vlae.teks: Die lug gee die suurstof wat diere en mense elke keer inasem.
vlae.rede: Content, not language: the protected entry for 'suurstof' says fish and most water animals use no air, yet this sentence says air gives the oxygen that animals breathe in, with no quantifier. Not changed, because narrowing it would alter what the sentence claims; for the writer or a person to judge.
